summary: Evaluate returns, funding capacity and investment choices with executive finance tools. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Executive financial strategy connects investment choices with returns, cash needs and funding capacity. For executives and senior finance leaders, this training develops practical skills to assess ROIC drivers with DuPont analysis, compare proposals using NPV and IRR, and test forecasts and debt capacity through scenario analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for executives who approve investments, set financial priorities or explain business performance. It suits intermediate learners who already work with budgets, financial statements or commercial decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with financial statements, budgeting or business performance reviews is expected. No programming is required. Excel access and a laptop are needed for spreadsheet-based case exercises.
